import openpyxl, os
p=os.environ['OUT_XLSX']
wb=openpyxl.load_workbook(p)
ws=wb.active
ref=ws['G2'].value
total=0
for r in range(1, ws.max_row+1):
    a=ws.cell(r,1).value
    b=ws.cell(r,2).value
    if a==ref or b==ref:
        for c in range(3,6):
            v=ws.cell(r,c).value
            if isinstance(v,(int,float)) and not isinstance(v,bool):
                total+=v
ws['H2']=total
wb.save(p)
print(total)
